+func (s *contentNodeShifter) collectAndMarkStaleIdentities(t *pageTrees, p *paths.Path) []identity.Identity {
+	s.staleKey = p.Base()
+	s.staleHits++
+	key := p.Base()
+	var ids []identity.Identity
+	nCount := 0
+	cb := func(n contentNodeI) bool {
+		if n == nil {
+			return false
+		}
+		s.observeContentNode(n)
+		n.MarkStale()
+		if nCount > 0 {
+			return true
+		}
+		nCount++
+		n.ForEeachIdentity(func(id identity.Identity) bool {
+			ids = append(ids, id)
+			return false
+		})
+		return false
+	}
+	tree := t.treePages
+	nCount = 0
+	tree.ForEeachInDimension(key, doctree.DimensionLanguage.Index(),
+		cb,
+	)
+
+	tree = t.treeResources
+	nCount = 0
+	tree.ForEeachInDimension(key, doctree.DimensionLanguage.Index(),
+		cb,
+	)
+
+	if p.Component() == files.ComponentFolderContent {
+		key := p.ForBundleType(paths.PathTypeContentResource).Base()
+		tree = t.treeResources
+		nCount = 0
+		tree.ForEeachInDimension(key, doctree.DimensionLanguage.Index(),
+			cb,
+		)
+	}
+	return ids
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) getOrCreateResourcesForPage(m *pageMap, ps *pageState) resource.Resources {
+	s.observeContentNode(ps)
+	s.resCount++
+	keyPage := ps.Path()
+	if keyPage == "/" {
+		keyPage = ""
+	}
+	key := keyPage + "/get-resources-for-page"
+	v, err := m.cacheResources.GetOrCreate(key, func(string) (resource.Resources, error) {
+		res, err := m.getResourcesForPage(ps)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+
+		if translationKey := ps.m.pageConfig.TranslationKey; translationKey != "" {
+			translatedPages, _ := m.s.h.translationKeyPages.Get(translationKey)
+			for _, tp := range translatedPages {
+				if tp == ps {
+					continue
+				}
+				tps := tp.(*pageState)
+				res2, err := tps.s.pageMap.getResourcesForPage(tps)
+				if err != nil {
+					return nil, err
+				}
+				for _, r := range res2 {
+					var found bool
+					for _, r2 := range res {
+						if r2.(resource.NameNormalizedProvider).NameNormalized() == r.(resource.NameNormalizedProvider).NameNormalized() {
+							found = true
+							break
+						}
+					}
+					if !found {
+						res = append(res, r)
+						s.resDupes++
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		lessFunc := func(i, j int) bool {
+			ri, rj := res[i], res[j]
+			if ri.ResourceType() < rj.ResourceType() {
+				return true
+			}
+
+			p1, ok1 := ri.(page.Page)
+			p2, ok2 := rj.(page.Page)
+
+			if ok1 != ok2 {
+				return ok2
+			}
+
+			if ok1 {
+				return page.DefaultPageSort(p1, p2)
+			}
+
+			return ri.Name() < rj.Name()
+		}
+
+		sort.SliceStable(res, lessFunc)
+
+		if len(ps.m.pageConfig.Resources) > 0 {
+			for i, r := range res {
+				res[i] = resources.CloneWithMetadataIfNeeded(ps.m.pageConfig.Resources, r)
+			}
+			sort.SliceStable(res, lessFunc)
+		}
+
+		s.resCount += len(res)
+		return res, nil
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+
+	return v
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) getPagesInSection(m *pageMap, q pageMapQueryPagesInSection) page.Pages {
+	s.sectionDepth = strings.Count(q.Path, "/")
+	s.sectionPages++
+	cacheKey := q.Key()
+
+	pages, err := m.getOrCreatePagesFromCache(nil, cacheKey, func(string) (page.Pages, error) {
+		prefix := paths.AddTrailingSlash(q.Path)
+
+		var (
+			pas         page.Pages
+			otherBranch string
+		)
+
+		include := q.Include
+		if include == nil {
+			include = pagePredicates.ShouldListLocal
+		}
+
+		w := &doctree.NodeShiftTreeWalker[contentNodeI]{
+			Tree:   m.treePages,
+			Prefix: prefix,
+		}
+
+		w.Handle = func(key string, n contentNodeI, match doctree.DimensionFlag) (bool, error) {
+			if q.Recursive {
+				if p, ok := n.(*pageState); ok && include(p) {
+					pas = append(pas, p)
+				}
+				return false, nil
+			}
+
+			if p, ok := n.(*pageState); ok && include(p) {
+				pas = append(pas, p)
+			}
+
+			if n.isContentNodeBranch() {
+				currentBranch := key + "/"
+				if otherBranch == "" || otherBranch != currentBranch {
+					w.SkipPrefix(currentBranch)
+				}
+				otherBranch = currentBranch
+			}
+			return false, nil
+		}
+
+		err := w.Walk(context.Background())
+
+		if err == nil {
+			if q.IncludeSelf {
+				if n := m.treePages.Get(q.Path); n != nil {
+					if p, ok := n.(*pageState); ok && include(p) {
+						pas = append(pas, p)
+					}
+				}
+			}
+			page.SortByDefault(pas)
+		}
+
+		s.sectionPages += len(pas)
+		return pas, err
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+
+	return pages
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) pagesForState(p *pageState) page.Pages {
+	s.observeContentNode(p)
+	s.kindHits++
+	switch p.Kind() {
+	case kinds.KindPage:
+		s.kindCode = 1
+	case kinds.KindSection, kinds.KindHome:
+		s.kindCode = 2
+		return p.s.pageMap.getPagesInSection(
+			pageMapQueryPagesInSection{
+				pageMapQueryPagesBelowPath: pageMapQueryPagesBelowPath{
+					Path:    p.Path(),
+					KeyPart: "page-section",
+					Include: pagePredicates.ShouldListLocal.And(
+						pagePredicates.KindPage.Or(pagePredicates.KindSection),
+					),
+				},
+			},
+		)
+	case kinds.KindTerm:
+		s.kindCode = 3
+		return p.s.pageMap.getPagesWithTerm(
+			pageMapQueryPagesBelowPath{
+				Path: p.Path(),
+			},
+		)
+	case kinds.KindTaxonomy:
+		s.kindCode = 4
+		return p.s.pageMap.getPagesInSection(
+			pageMapQueryPagesInSection{
+				pageMapQueryPagesBelowPath: pageMapQueryPagesBelowPath{
+					Path:    p.Path(),
+					KeyPart: "term",
+					Include: pagePredicates.ShouldListLocal.And(pagePredicates.KindTerm),
+				},
+				Recursive: true,
+			},
+		)
+	default:
+		s.kindCode = 5
+		return p.s.Pages()
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) allTranslationsForState(p *pageState) page.Pages {
+	s.observeContentNode(p)
+	s.transCount++
+	key := p.Path() + "/" + "translations-all"
+	pages, err := p.s.pageMap.getOrCreatePagesFromCache(p.s.pageMap.cachePages2, key, func(string) (page.Pages, error) {
+		if p.m.pageConfig.TranslationKey != "" {
+			pas, _ := p.s.h.translationKeyPages.Get(p.m.pageConfig.TranslationKey)
+			pasc := make(page.Pages, len(pas))
+			copy(pasc, pas)
+			page.SortByLanguage(pasc)
+			s.transCount += len(pasc)
+			return pasc, nil
+		}
+		var pas page.Pages
+		p.s.pageMap.treePages.ForEeachInDimension(p.Path(), doctree.DimensionLanguage.Index(),
+			func(n contentNodeI) bool {
+				if n != nil {
+					pas = append(pas, n.(page.Page))
+				}
+				return false
+			},
+		)
+
+		pas = pagePredicates.ShouldLink.Filter(pas)
+		page.SortByLanguage(pas)
+		s.transCount += len(pas)
+		return pas, nil
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+
+	return pages
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) shiftOutputFormatForState(p *pageState, isRenderingSite bool, idx int) error {
+	s.formatIdx = idx
+	s.formatCount++
+	s.observeContentNode(p)
+	if err := p.initPage(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	if len(p.pageOutputs) == 1 {
+		idx = 0
+	}
+
+	p.pageOutputIdx = idx
+	p.pageOutput = p.pageOutputs[idx]
+	if p.pageOutput == nil {
+		panic(fmt.Sprintf("pageOutput is nil for output idx %d", idx))
+	}
+
+	if isRenderingSite && p.pageOutput.paginator != nil && p.pageOutput.paginator.current != nil {
+		p.pageOutput.paginator.reset()
+	}
+
+	if isRenderingSite {
+		cp := p.pageOutput.pco
+		if cp == nil && p.reusePageOutputContent() {
+			for i := 0; i < len(p.pageOutputs); i++ {
+				if i == idx {
+					continue
+				}
+				po := p.pageOutputs[i]
+

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) applyPageMetaPost(ps *pageState, cascade map[page.PageMatcher]maps.Params) error {
+	s.observeContentNode(ps)
+	s.paramHits++
+	ps.m.setMetaPostCount++
+	var cascadeHashPre uint64
+	if ps.m.setMetaPostCount > 1 {
+		cascadeHashPre = identity.HashUint64(ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade)
+		ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade = xmaps.Clone[map[page.PageMatcher]maps.Params](ps.m.cascadeOriginal)
+	}
+
+	if cascade != nil {
+		if ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade != nil {
+			for k, v := range cascade {
+				vv, found := ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade[k]
+				if !found {
+					ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade[k] = v
+				} else {
+					for ck, cv := range v {
+						if _, found := vv[ck]; !found {
+							vv[ck] = cv
+						}
+					}
+				}
+			}
+			cascade = ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade
+		} else {
+			ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade = cascade
+		}
+	}
+
+	if cascade == nil {
+		cascade = ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade
+	}
+
+	if ps.m.setMetaPostCount > 1 {
+		ps.m.setMetaPostCascadeChanged = cascadeHashPre != identity.HashUint64(ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade)
+		if !ps.m.setMetaPostCascadeChanged {
+			ps.m.pageConfig.Dates = ps.m.datesOriginal
+			return nil
+		}
+		ps.m.setMetaPostPrepareRebuild()
+	}
+
+	for m, v := range cascade {
+		if !m.Matches(ps) {
+			continue
+		}
+		for kk, vv := range v {
+			if _, found := ps.m.pageConfig.Params[kk]; !found {
+				ps.m.pageConfig.Params[kk] = vv
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	if err := ps.setMetaPostParams(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	if err := ps.m.applyDefaultValues(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	ps.m.datesOriginal = ps.m.pageConfig.Dates
+	s.cascadeSize = len(cascade)
+	return nil
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) renderPageContent(ctx context.Context, c *cachedContent, cp *pageContentOutput) (contentSummary, error) {
+	s.renderBytes++
+	ctx = tpl.Context.DependencyScope.Set(ctx, pageDependencyScopeGlobal)
+	key := c.pi.sourceKey + "/" + cp.po.f.Name
+	versionv := cp.contentRenderedVersion
+
+	v, err := c.pm.cacheContentRendered.GetOrCreate(key, func(string) (*resources.StaleValue[contentSummary], error) {
+		cp.po.p.s.Log.Trace(logg.StringFunc(func() string {
+			return fmt.Sprintln("contentRendered", key)
+		}))
+
+		cp.po.p.s.h.contentRenderCounter.Add(1)
+		cp.contentRendered = true
+		po := cp.po
+
+		ct, err := c.contentToC(ctx, cp)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+
+		rs := &resources.StaleValue[contentSummary]{
+			IsStaleFunc: func() bool {
+				return c.IsStale() || cp.contentRenderedVersion != versionv
+			},
+		}
+
+		if len(c.pi.itemsStep2) == 0 {
+			return rs, nil
+		}
+
+		var b []byte
+
+		if ct.astDoc != nil {
+			r, ok, err := po.contentRenderer.RenderContent(ctx, ct.contentToRender, ct.astDoc)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, err
+			}
+
+			if !ok {
+				return nil, errors.New("invalid state: astDoc is set but RenderContent returned false")
+			}
+
+			b = r.Bytes()
+
+		} else {
+			b = make([]byte, len(ct.contentToRender))
+			copy(b, ct.contentToRender)
+		}
+
+		var hasShortcodeVariants bool
+		tokenHandler := func(ctx context.Context, token string) ([]byte, error) {
+			s.tokenCount++
+			if token == tocShortcodePlaceholder {
+				return []byte(ct.tableOfContentsHTML), nil
+			}
+			renderer, found := ct.contentPlaceholders[token]
+			if found {
+				repl, more, err := renderer.renderShortcode(ctx)
+				if err != nil {
+					return nil, err
+				}
+				hasShortcodeVariants = hasShortcodeVariants || more
+				return repl, nil
+			}
+			panic(fmt.Errorf("unknown shortcode token %q (number of tokens: %d)", token, len(ct.contentPlaceholders)))
+		}
+
+		b, err = expandShortcodeTokens(ctx, b, tokenHandler)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		if hasShortcodeVariants {
+			cp.po.p.pageOutputTemplateVariationsState.Add(1)
+		}
+
+		var result contentSummary
+
+		if c.pi.hasSummaryDivider {
+			isHTML := cp.po.p.m.pageConfig.Markup == "html"
+			if isHTML {
+				i := bytes.Index(b, internalSummaryDividerPre)
+				result.summary = helpers.BytesToHTML(b[:i])
+				b = b[i+len(internalSummaryDividerPre):]
+			} else {
+				summary, content, err := splitUserDefinedSummaryAndContent(cp.po.p.m.pageConfig.Markup, b)
+				if err != nil {
+					cp.po.p.s.Log.Errorf("Failed to set user defined summary for page %q: %s", cp.po.p.pathOrTitle(), err)
+				} else {
+					b = content
+					result.summary = helpers.BytesToHTML(summary)
+				}
+			}
+			result.summaryTruncated = c.pi.summaryTruncated
+		}
+		result.content = helpers.BytesToHTML(b)
+		rs.Value = result
+		s.renderBytes += len(b)
+		s.summaryLen = len(result.summary)
+
+		return rs, nil
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		return contentSummary{}, cp.po.p.wrapError(err)
+	}
+
+	return v.Value, nil
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) addFileInfo(m *pageMap, fi hugofs.FileMetaInfo) error {
+	s.bundleFiles++
+	if fi.IsDir() {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	insertResource := func(fim hugofs.FileMetaInfo) error {
+		pi := fi.Meta().PathInfo
+		key := pi.Base()
+		tree := m.treeResources
+
+		commit := tree.Lock(true)
+		defer commit()
+
+		r := func() (hugio.ReadSeekCloser, error) {
+			return fim.Meta().Open()
+		}
+
+		var rs *resourceSource
+		if pi.IsContent() {
+			pageResource, pi, err := m.s.h.newPage(
+				&pageMeta{
+					f:        source.NewFileInfo(fim),
+					pathInfo: pi,
+					bundled:  true,
+				},
+			)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			if pageResource == nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			key = pi.Base()
+			s.bundleCode = 1
+			rs = &resourceSource{r: pageResource}
+		} else {
+			s.bundleCode = 2
+			rs = &resourceSource{path: pi, opener: r, fi: fim}
+		}
+
+		tree.InsertIntoValuesDimension(key, rs)
+		s.observeContentNode(rs)
+
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	meta := fi.Meta()
+	pi := meta.PathInfo
+
+	switch pi.BundleType() {
+	case paths.PathTypeFile, paths.PathTypeContentResource:
+		m.s.Log.Trace(logg.StringFunc(
+			func() string {
+				return fmt.Sprintf("insert resource: %q", fi.Meta().Filename)
+			},
+		))
+		if err := insertResource(fi); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	default:
+		m.s.Log.Trace(logg.StringFunc(
+			func() string {
+				return fmt.Sprintf("insert bundle: %q", fi.Meta().Filename)
+			},
+		))
+		p, pi, err := m.s.h.newPage(
+			&pageMeta{
+				f:        source.NewFileInfo(fi),
+				pathInfo: pi,
+				bundled:  false,
+			},
+		)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if p == nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		s.bundleCode = 3
+		s.observeContentNode(p)
+		m.treePages.InsertWithLock(pi.Base(), p)
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) collectAndMarkStaleIdentities(t *pageTrees, p *paths.Path) []identity.Identity {
+	s.staleKey = p.Base()
+	s.staleHits++
+	key := p.Base()
+	var ids []identity.Identity
+	nCount := 0
+	cb := func(n contentNodeI) bool {
+		if n == nil {
+			return false
+		}
+		s.observeContentNode(n)
+		n.MarkStale()
+		if nCount > 0 {
+			return true
+		}
+		nCount++
+		n.ForEeachIdentity(func(id identity.Identity) bool {
+			ids = append(ids, id)
+			return false
+		})
+		return false
+	}
+	tree := t.treePages
+	nCount = 0
+	tree.ForEeachInDimension(key, doctree.DimensionLanguage.Index(),
+		cb,
+	)
+
+	tree = t.treeResources
+	nCount = 0
+	tree.ForEeachInDimension(key, doctree.DimensionLanguage.Index(),
+		cb,
+	)
+
+	if p.Component() == files.ComponentFolderContent {
+		key := p.ForBundleType(paths.PathTypeContentResource).Base()
+		tree = t.treeResources
+		nCount = 0
+		tree.ForEeachInDimension(key, doctree.DimensionLanguage.Index(),
+			cb,
+		)
+	}
+	return ids
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) getOrCreateResourcesForPage(m *pageMap, ps *pageState) resource.Resources {
+	s.observeContentNode(ps)
+	s.resCount++
+	keyPage := ps.Path()
+	if keyPage == "/" {
+		keyPage = ""
+	}
+	key := keyPage + "/get-resources-for-page"
+	v, err := m.cacheResources.GetOrCreate(key, func(string) (resource.Resources, error) {
+		res, err := m.getResourcesForPage(ps)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+
+		if translationKey := ps.m.pageConfig.TranslationKey; translationKey != "" {
+			translatedPages, _ := m.s.h.translationKeyPages.Get(translationKey)
+			for _, tp := range translatedPages {
+				if tp == ps {
+					continue
+				}
+				tps := tp.(*pageState)
+				res2, err := tps.s.pageMap.getResourcesForPage(tps)
+				if err != nil {
+					return nil, err
+				}
+				for _, r := range res2 {
+					var found bool
+					for _, r2 := range res {
+						if r2.(resource.NameNormalizedProvider).NameNormalized() == r.(resource.NameNormalizedProvider).NameNormalized() {
+							found = true
+							break
+						}
+					}
+					if !found {
+						res = append(res, r)
+						s.resDupes++
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		lessFunc := func(i, j int) bool {
+			ri, rj := res[i], res[j]
+			if ri.ResourceType() < rj.ResourceType() {
+				return true
+			}
+
+			p1, ok1 := ri.(page.Page)
+			p2, ok2 := rj.(page.Page)
+
+			if ok1 != ok2 {
+				return ok2
+			}
+
+			if ok1 {
+				return page.DefaultPageSort(p1, p2)
+			}
+
+			return ri.Name() < rj.Name()
+		}
+
+		sort.SliceStable(res, lessFunc)
+
+		if len(ps.m.pageConfig.Resources) > 0 {
+			for i, r := range res {
+				res[i] = resources.CloneWithMetadataIfNeeded(ps.m.pageConfig.Resources, r)
+			}
+			sort.SliceStable(res, lessFunc)
+		}
+
+		s.resCount += len(res)
+		return res, nil
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+
+	return v
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) getPagesInSection(m *pageMap, q pageMapQueryPagesInSection) page.Pages {
+	s.sectionDepth = strings.Count(q.Path, "/")
+	s.sectionPages++
+	cacheKey := q.Key()
+
+	pages, err := m.getOrCreatePagesFromCache(nil, cacheKey, func(string) (page.Pages, error) {
+		prefix := paths.AddTrailingSlash(q.Path)
+
+		var (
+			pas         page.Pages
+			otherBranch string
+		)
+
+		include := q.Include
+		if include == nil {
+			include = pagePredicates.ShouldListLocal
+		}
+
+		w := &doctree.NodeShiftTreeWalker[contentNodeI]{
+			Tree:   m.treePages,
+			Prefix: prefix,
+		}
+
+		w.Handle = func(key string, n contentNodeI, match doctree.DimensionFlag) (bool, error) {
+			if q.Recursive {
+				if p, ok := n.(*pageState); ok && include(p) {
+					pas = append(pas, p)
+				}
+				return false, nil
+			}
+
+			if p, ok := n.(*pageState); ok && include(p) {
+				pas = append(pas, p)
+			}
+
+			if n.isContentNodeBranch() {
+				currentBranch := key + "/"
+				if otherBranch == "" || otherBranch != currentBranch {
+					w.SkipPrefix(currentBranch)
+				}
+				otherBranch = currentBranch
+			}
+			return false, nil
+		}
+
+		err := w.Walk(context.Background())
+
+		if err == nil {
+			if q.IncludeSelf {
+				if n := m.treePages.Get(q.Path); n != nil {
+					if p, ok := n.(*pageState); ok && include(p) {
+						pas = append(pas, p)
+					}
+				}
+			}
+			page.SortByDefault(pas)
+		}
+
+		s.sectionPages += len(pas)
+		return pas, err
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+
+	return pages
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) shiftOutputFormatForState(p *pageState, isRenderingSite bool, idx int) error {
+	s.formatIdx = idx
+	s.formatCount++
+	s.observeContentNode(p)
+	if err := p.initPage(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	if len(p.pageOutputs) == 1 {
+		idx = 0
+	}
+
+	p.pageOutputIdx = idx
+	p.pageOutput = p.pageOutputs[idx]
+	if p.pageOutput == nil {
+		panic(fmt.Sprintf("pageOutput is nil for output idx %d", idx))
+	}
+
+	if isRenderingSite && p.pageOutput.paginator != nil && p.pageOutput.paginator.current != nil {
+		p.pageOutput.paginator.reset()
+	}
+
+	if isRenderingSite {
+		cp := p.pageOutput.pco
+		if cp == nil && p.reusePageOutputContent() {
+			for i := 0; i < len(p.pageOutputs); i++ {
+				if i == idx {
+					continue
+				}
+				po := p.pageOutputs[i]
+
+				if po.pco != nil {
+					cp = po.pco
+					break
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		if cp == nil {
+			var err error
+			cp, err = newPageContentOutput(p.pageOutput)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+		p.pageOutput.setContentProvider(cp)
+	} else {
+		if lcp, ok := (p.pageOutput.ContentProvider.(*page.LazyContentProvider)); ok {
+			lcp.Reset()
+		} else {
+			lcp = page.NewLazyContentProvider(func() (page.OutputFormatContentProvider, error) {
+				cp, err := newPageContentOutput(p.pageOutput)
+				if err != nil {
+					return nil, err
+				}
+				return cp, nil
+			})
+			p.pageOutput.contentRenderer = lcp
+			p.pageOutput.ContentProvider = lcp
+			p.pageOutput.PageRenderProvider = lcp
+			p.pageOutput.TableOfContentsProvider = lcp
+		}
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) applyPageMetaPost(ps *pageState, cascade map[page.PageMatcher]maps.Params) error {
+	s.observeContentNode(ps)
+	s.paramHits++
+	ps.m.setMetaPostCount++
+	var cascadeHashPre uint64
+	if ps.m.setMetaPostCount > 1 {
+		cascadeHashPre = identity.HashUint64(ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade)
+		ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade = xmaps.Clone[map[page.PageMatcher]maps.Params](ps.m.cascadeOriginal)
+	}
+
+	if cascade != nil {
+		if ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade != nil {
+			for k, v := range cascade {
+				vv, found := ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade[k]
+				if !found {
+					ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade[k] = v
+				} else {
+					for ck, cv := range v {
+						if _, found := vv[ck]; !found {
+							vv[ck] = cv
+						}
+					}
+				}
+			}
+			cascade = ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade
+		} else {
+			ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade = cascade
+		}
+	}
+
+	if cascade == nil {
+		cascade = ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade
+	}
+
+	if ps.m.setMetaPostCount > 1 {
+		ps.m.setMetaPostCascadeChanged = cascadeHashPre != identity.HashUint64(ps.m.pageConfig.Cascade)
+		if !ps.m.setMetaPostCascadeChanged {
+			ps.m.pageConfig.Dates = ps.m.datesOriginal
+			return nil
+		}
+		ps.m.setMetaPostPrepareRebuild()
+	}
+
+	for m, v := range cascade {
+		if !m.Matches(ps) {
+			continue
+		}
+		for kk, vv := range v {
+			if _, found := ps.m.pageConfig.Params[kk]; !found {
+				ps.m.pageConfig.Params[kk] = vv
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	if err := ps.setMetaPostParams(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	if err := ps.m.applyDefaultValues(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	ps.m.datesOriginal = ps.m.pageConfig.Dates
+	s.cascadeSize = len(cascade)
+	return nil
+}

+func (s *contentNodeShifter) renderPageContent(ctx context.Context, c *cachedContent, cp *pageContentOutput) (contentSummary, error) {
+	s.renderBytes++
+	ctx = tpl.Context.DependencyScope.Set(ctx, pageDependencyScopeGlobal)
+	key := c.pi.sourceKey + "/" + cp.po.f.Name
+	versionv := cp.contentRenderedVersion
+
+	v, err := c.pm.cacheContentRendered.GetOrCreate(key, func(string) (*resources.StaleValue[contentSummary], error) {
+		cp.po.p.s.Log.Trace(logg.StringFunc(func() string {
+			return fmt.Sprintln("contentRendered", key)
+		}))
+
+		cp.po.p.s.h.contentRenderCounter.Add(1)
+		cp.contentRendered = true
+		po := cp.po
+
+		ct, err := c.contentToC(ctx, cp)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+
+		rs := &resources.StaleValue[contentSummary]{
+			IsStaleFunc: func() bool {
+				return c.IsStale() || cp.contentRenderedVersion != versionv
+			},
+		}
+
+		if len(c.pi.itemsStep2) == 0 {
+			return rs, nil
+		}
+
+		var b []byte
+
+		if ct.astDoc != nil {
+			r, ok, err := po.contentRenderer.RenderContent(ctx, ct.contentToRender, ct.astDoc)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, err
+			}

When replacing a page or language-specific resource node, Hugo now marks the outgoing object stale only if it differs from the replacement. This ensures the prior rendered output and dependent state are invalidated, so a subsequent change to another page is rendered and live-reloaded correctly.

Validated with:

- `go test ./hugolib -run TestRebuildHomeThenPageIssue12436 -count=1`
- `go test ./hugolib -run "^TestRebuild" -count=1`
- `git diff --check`

Only `hugolib/content_map_page.go` is modified; no tests were changed, staged, or committed.
